assumption.holdDuration: Drawn from the RANDOM-ENTRY BASELINE barsHeldStats histogram, not strategy outcomes.
assumption.singleGlobalSlot: Exactly one slot per card and one separate combined Compass book slot; each slot holds at most one position, long OR short.
assumption.noOutcomes: No strategy P&L or result enters this emulation.

slotArchitecture.cardMeasurement: Each of 22 cards has exactly one independent one-position slot; another card cannot block its measured card-level count. Long and short cannot coexist in one card's slot.
slotArchitecture.familyReporting: Family totals are sums of independent card-slot survivors; variants do not block each other for this measurement.
slotArchitecture.compassValidation: Combined Compass/validation book has exactly one position total. At a shared bar, lowest frozen numeric priority wins; only that candidate may enter. Long and short cannot coexist in the book. This is separate from the per-card claim sample.
slotArchitecture.ownerApproval: A6 records the owner's pre-result DRAFT design: one slot per card for claim testing and one combined priority-resolved slot for Compass/validation. No strategy verification is run.

inputs.holdSampling: one independent deterministic baseline-hold sampler per card, seed 20261027 + sum of card-id character codes; same baseline histogram, not strategy exits

combinedBook.priorityRule: same-bar winner = smallest frozen numeric priority; one global slot afterwards
combinedBook.note: This is Compass/validation capacity illustration only, not the claim-level power denominator.

realHarnessAudit.harness: verify-claims.mjs runBattery currently receives externally produced trades; it groups variants at family|verdictState and does not apply card priorities or enforce a card-specific slot itself.
realHarnessAudit.crossCardBlocking: No strategy-signal-to-trade M6 producer exists; therefore cross-card blocking in the real harness is neither performed nor measured. The earlier global 7,401-kept model incorrectly conflated claim-specific samples with a portfolio execution slot.
realHarnessAudit.requiredBeforeRealVerification: M6 must produce per-card slot-constrained DEV trades for claim-level validation, and a separate priority-resolved single-book stream for Compass; reject a batch lacking that distinction.

note: Counts are signal-survival model counts only; baseline-sampled duration is an assumption. No P&L, verdict, threshold, Map, exit, cost or criterion is changed.
